channel.title: Redmi Buds Bar updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Redmi Buds Bar.

item.description:
• Keep pending Mac control connections after a timeout to prevent duplicate attempts, with clear recovery instructions.
  • Configure earbud gestures, noise-mode cycling, EQ and supported feature settings on Mac and iPhone, with independent readback after changes.
  • Add ear tip fit testing and find-earbud sound controls.
  • Provide an unsigned iPhone IPA with Control Center controls and instructions for signing it yourself.

• Check, download and install official REDMI Buds 8 Pro firmware from the Mac without a Xiaomi account.
  • Use the native macOS menu window and background while keeping the familiar battery, noise and playback controls.
  • Release idle control connections so Mac and iPhone controls can take turns without disconnecting audio.
  • Add the iPhone app source with direct noise controls, Control Center cycling, diagnostics and firmware updates.

• Control music from the menu bar with artwork, track and artist details, and the source app.
  • Play, pause, skip tracks, return to the previous track, and seek without opening the music app.
  • Keep playback controls visually steady when pausing or resuming.
  • Reduce background resource use by loading controls on demand, releasing closed views and media caches, and reusing appropriately sized artwork.
